subject.why: The engagement ring is instantly recognizable, complete with a gold band, diamond, prongs, and the requested engraved heart detail.

category.why: The ring floats in mid-air at a three-quarter tilted angle over a saturated background with concentric circular rings, matching category 1 requirements.

clean.why: There is no text, UI, borders, watermarks, or characters present.

framing.why: The object is centrally framed with comfortable margins on all four sides.

colour.why: Vibrant and saturated purple background contrasting cleanly against the warm gold band and crisp diamond.

detail.why: Chunky, clean shapes without noisy micro-textures, scratches, or unnecessary props.

style.why: Matches the reference cards with smooth, chunky 3D volumes, soft satin sheen, and no outlines.
